title: Israel scattered among all nations after Rome

given.label: c. 1436 BC (end of the wilderness years)

fulfilment: History: the Bar Kokhba revolt and Hadrian's expulsion; exile until 1948
summary: Moses warned that Israel would be scattered from one end of the earth to the other with no rest for the foot. Johnson dates the Roman dispersion to AD 132 (4057 AM) and says the nation ceased to exist for 1,816 years, until 1948.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 132 Great Dispersion"
Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "The Great Dispersion"

title: Israel many days without king, prince or sacrifice
fulfilment: History: no Jewish king or Temple sacrifice since AD 70
summary: Hosea said Israel would live many days without a king or sacrifice and return to seek the LORD and David their king in the latter days. The first half has held since the Temple fell. The return to "David their king" is still future.

title: Jews a byword and proverb among the nations

given.label: c. 1436 BC (end of the wilderness years)

fulfilment: History: centuries of antisemitism, expulsions and pogroms
summary: Moses and Jeremiah foresaw the scattered people becoming a taunt and a byword. Expulsions from England (1290), France (1306) and Spain (1492), the pogroms and the Holocaust are usually cited as fulfilments.

title: The Jewish people preserved through the dispersion
fulfilment: History: distinct Jewish identity kept for 1,800+ years in exile
summary: God promised that although he would make a full end of the nations where Israel was scattered, he would not make a full end of Israel. They would remain a nation before him as long as the sun and moon endure. The Jews stayed a distinct people through the whole exile and the Holocaust.

title: The land left desolate while Israel is in exile
fulfilment: History: travellers' accounts of a barren, thinly settled land
summary: The land would lie desolate and enemies living there would be astonished at it. Evangelical writers point to the barren, sparsely settled land described by 19th-century visitors such as Mark Twain (1867).

title: Smyrna era: "tribulation ten days", the Roman persecutions
fulfilment: History: the persecutions from Nero to Diocletian, ended by the Edict of Milan
summary: Johnson reads the seven churches as seven church ages and starts the Smyrna age in AD 64. Many evangelicals read its "ten days" of tribulation as the ten imperial persecutions, which ended in 313.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 64 Smyrna – The Synagogue of Satan"

title: Pergamos era: church joined to state (AD 312)
fulfilment: History: Constantine's conversion and the state church
summary: Johnson dates the Pergamos age, with its stumbling block of Balaam, from AD 312. In this era he places the rise of amillennialism, cessationism and church tradition, which he sees as departures from the early teaching.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 312 Pergamos – Balaam's Stumbling Block"

title: Rome divided and the Western Empire falls (395–476)
fulfilment: History: the empire split in 395; Romulus Augustulus deposed 4 Sept 476
summary: The iron kingdom would be divided, partly strong and partly broken. Johnson's outline dates the fall of Rome to 395–476. The empire split East and West in 395, and the West fell in 476.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 395-476 Fall of Rome"
Wikipedia, Fall of the Western Roman Empire

title: Rise of Papal Rome (476–1423), in Johnson's empire sequence
fulfilment: History: the medieval papacy as the leading power in the West
summary: Johnson's book traces a run of beast-empires after Rome, starting with Papal Rome from 476 to 1423. His Dragon-Heads chart suggests he reads this from the heads of the beast. The verse he uses could not be read and is inferred.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 476-1423 Rise of Papal Rome"

title: Thyatira era: Jezebel and the "depths of Satan" (AD 606)
fulfilment: History: medieval church (Johnson links it with Gnosticism)
summary: Johnson starts the Thyatira age in AD 606 and links its Jezebel teaching with Gnostic-style error in the medieval church.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 606 Thyatira – Jezebel, Depths of Satan"

title: Enoch's 7th week: an apostate generation, then a sevenfold instruction
fulfilment: History (Johnson): Hillel II calendar AD 359; Karaite search c. AD 900
summary: Johnson reads Enoch's seventh week (4201–4900 AM) as the era when Jews took up Hillel II's calendar (AD 359) and Christians forgot the Zadok teaching. He links the closing "sevenfold instruction" to a search for those lost teachings around AD 900. He treats Enoch as genuine prophecy.

title: Rise of Germany (1423–1917), in Johnson's empire sequence
fulfilment: History: Holy Roman Empire / German power
summary: In Johnson's chain of empires, German power follows Papal Rome from 1423 to 1917. The verse he uses could not be read and is inferred.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1423 to 1917 Rise of Germany"

title: Sardis era: a name of life but dead ritual
fulfilment: History: Reformation-era and state churches
summary: Johnson names Sardis "dead ritual" but no start year was visible in his contents. The date given here follows the common evangelical view that this age starts with the Reformation.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Sardis – Dead Ritual"

title: Enoch's 8th week: a "house" for the righteous, read as the Reformation
fulfilment: History (Johnson): Protestant Reformation; Geneva Bible (1560) and King James Bible (1611)
summary: Johnson reads the eighth week's "house" as the Protestant Reformation. In its last century (AD 1576–1675) came the Geneva and King James Bibles, which drove the work of translating Scripture into every language.

title: Philadelphia era: an open door, the missionary church (1750)
fulfilment: History: the Great Awakening and the modern missions movement
summary: Johnson dates the Philadelphia "open door" age from about 1750 and calls it the missionary church. It matches the revivals and the worldwide missions movement.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1750 Philadelphia – Missionary Church"

title: Enoch's 9th week: righteous judgment revealed, read as Israel reborn
fulfilment: History: State of Israel, 1948
summary: Johnson takes the ninth week (5601–6300 AM) as the time the righteous judgment is shown to the world. He identifies this with Israel's rebirth in 1948, followed by the Great Tribulation and the start of the Millennium, which are still future.

title: Rise of Russia (1917–1945), in Johnson's empire sequence
fulfilment: History: the Soviet state
summary: Johnson's empire chain ends, before modern Israel, with Russia's rise from 1917 to 1945. The verse he uses could not be read and is inferred.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1917 to 1945 Rise of Russia"

title: Fishers then hunters drive the Jews home
fulfilment: History: Zionism (the "fishers") and the persecutions and Holocaust (the "hunters")
summary: God would send fishers and then hunters to bring his people out of every hiding place. Many evangelicals read this as Zionist appeals followed by the persecutions that drove Jews toward the land.

title: The Lord gathers his people "the second time" from the four corners
fulfilment: History: the aliyot from 1882, mass immigration after 1948
summary: Isaiah foresaw a second worldwide regathering, after the return from Babylon, from the four corners of the earth. Evangelicals see it in the waves of aliyah since 1882, still going on.

sources.name: Chuck Smith, Through the Bible (C2000), Ezekiel 37

title: A return so great it eclipses the Exodus
fulfilment: History: Jews returning from over 100 countries
summary: People would no longer swear by the God who brought Israel out of Egypt, but by the God who brought them out of the north country and all the lands. The modern return from many nations is cited as fulfilling it.

sources.name: Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)

title: Gathered out of all countries into their own land
fulfilment: History: the ingathering after independence
summary: God promised to take Israel from among the nations and bring them into their own land. Evangelicals point to the modern ingathering since 1948 as the main fulfilment so far.

sources.name: Chuck Smith, Through the Bible (C2000), Ezekiel 37
Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)

title: Valley of dry bones: a dead nation brought back to life
fulfilment: History: State of Israel proclaimed
summary: Ezekiel saw dry bones come together and live: the whole house of Israel, back in its land. Chuck Smith calls it a nation dead for nineteen centuries that would live again. Coming back first and receiving the Spirit later is read as fitting a secular state now and a spiritual revival still to come.

sources.name: Chuck Smith, Through the Bible (C2000), Ezekiel 37
Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)
Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1948 The Rebirth of Israel"

title: Israel reborn as one nation, not two kingdoms
fulfilment: History: one state, not Israel and Judah
summary: The two sticks of Judah and Joseph become one in God's hand, and the people are no longer two nations. Modern Israel was founded as one nation. Chuck Smith adds that the one king over them is Christ, still to come.

sources.name: Chuck Smith, Through the Bible (C2000), Ezekiel 37
Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)

title: A nation born in one day: Israel, 14 May 1948
fulfilment: History: Declaration of Independence; US recognition the same day
summary: Isaiah asked whether a nation could be born at once and said Zion would give birth before her labour pains. Israel declared independence and was recognised on 14 May 1948. Johnson's calendar puts it at 5873 AM, in Iyar, and calls it Israel's second birth.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1948 The Rebirth of Israel"
Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)

title: Ezekiel 4's 430 years ×7 point to 1948 (Grant Jeffrey)
fulfilment: History: State of Israel
summary: Grant Jeffrey took Ezekiel's 430 days as years, subtracted the 70-year captivity and multiplied the remaining 360 by seven (Leviticus 26:18). Using 360-day years he counted 2,520 years from 536 BC to May 1948. The calculation is his and is disputed. Johnson's visible material does not use it.

sources.name: Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)
Guy Cramer, critique and revision of Jeffrey's Ezekiel 4 calculation

title: Four craftsmen cast down the horns that scattered Judah
fulfilment: History (Johnson): Israel's rebirth
summary: Zechariah saw four horns that scattered Judah and four craftsmen sent to cast them down. Johnson places this fulfilment in 1948. How he identifies the four could not be read.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1948 The Four Craftsmen"

title: Laodicea era: the lukewarm church (from 1948)
fulfilment: History: the present church age
summary: Johnson dates the last church age, lukewarm Laodicea, from 1948. It runs until the Rapture.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1948 Laodicea – Lukewarm Church"

title: Micah's 1st shepherd: Ben-Gurion and the Syrian front (1948–49)
fulfilment: History: War of Independence; Israel–Syria armistice
summary: Johnson reads the seven shepherds and eight leaders as Israel's defence ministers and prime ministers. Each shepherd fights Syria ("Assyria") over Bashan, the Golan. The first is Ben-Gurion in the War of Independence, ending with the armistice of 20 July 1949.

sources.name: Biblefacts.org, Seven Shepherds chart (Ken Johnson ministry)
Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1948-1981 Seven Shepherds"

title: Yemenite Jews flown home "on eagles' wings" (1949)
fulfilment: History: about 49,000 Yemenite Jews airlifted
summary: Johnson has a 1949 entry for the return of the Yemenite Jews. Operation Magic Carpet airlifted about 49,000 of them, many of whom recalled the promise of "eagles' wings". The prophecy reference here is inferred.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1949 Yemenite Jews Return"

title: A "pure language" restored: Hebrew revived
fulfilment: History: Eliezer Ben-Yehuda; Hebrew becomes a national language
summary: Zephaniah foresaw God giving the peoples a pure language to call on his name. Jeremiah foresaw Judah once again using the old blessing in its own speech. The revival of Hebrew as an everyday spoken language, the only such case, is often cited.

sources.name: Wikipedia, Revival of the Hebrew language

title: The desert blossoms like the rose
fulfilment: History: reclamation, afforestation, drip irrigation
summary: Isaiah saw the wilderness rejoice and blossom, with water bursting out in the desert. Evangelicals point to the reforestation and farming of the land since the late 1800s.

title: The desolate land tilled again, like the garden of Eden
fulfilment: History: resettlement and rebuilding of cities
summary: The mountains of Israel would bear fruit for the returning people, and passers-by would say the desolate land had become like Eden. Ruined cities would be rebuilt and inhabited.

title: Israel fills the face of the world with fruit
fulfilment: History: Israel's agricultural exports
summary: Israel would blossom and bud and fill the world with fruit. Its farm exports and technology are cited. Some read the verse spiritually.

title: Planted in the land, never to be uprooted again
fulfilment: History: Israel survives every war since 1948
summary: Amos foresaw the exiles rebuilding waste cities, planting vineyards and never again being pulled up from their land. Evangelicals hold that Israel's survival of the wars since 1948 fits this.

sources.name: Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)

title: Israel's few defeat the many (1948, 1967, 1973)
fulfilment: History: War of Independence, Six-Day War, Yom Kippur War
summary: Five would chase a hundred, and Judah would be like a firepot among sheaves. Israel's wins against larger armies in 1948, 1967 and 1973 are the usual examples.

sources.name: Watchman Bible Study, "10 Prophecies Fulfilled in 1948" (cites Grant Jeffrey and Ken Johnson)

title: Ashdod and Ashkelon resettled by Judah (from 1951)
fulfilment: History: modern Israeli cities of Ashdod and Ashkelon
summary: Zephaniah said the coast would belong to the remnant of Judah, who would lie down in the houses of Ashkelon. Johnson's 1951–2005 entry covers the Israeli resettlement of Ashdod and Ashkelon.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1951-2005 Ashdod, Ashkalon, and Gaza"

title: "Gaza shall be forsaken": Israel leaves Gaza (2005)
fulfilment: History: Israel's disengagement from Gaza
summary: Johnson ends his Ashdod–Ashkelon–Gaza entry in 2005 and, in The Rapture, names the handover of Gaza as an event before the Rapture. Israel's withdrawal from Gaza was completed on 12 September 2005.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1951-2005 Ashdod, Ashkalon, and Gaza"

title: Jerusalem trodden down until the times of the Gentiles (7 June 1967)
fulfilment: History: Israeli troops take the Old City and Temple Mount
summary: Jesus said Jerusalem would be trodden down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles were fulfilled. Israel took the Old City on 7 June 1967. Chuck Smith saw this as the end of Gentile rule over the city. Johnson dates "Israel takes the Temple Mount" to 5892 AM, in Sivan.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1967 The Temple Mount Taken"
Chuck Smith, Sermon Notes on Luke 21:36

title: Micah's 2nd shepherd: Dayan takes the Golan (1967)
fulfilment: History: Golan Heights captured in the Six-Day War
summary: In Johnson's reading the second leader is Levi Eshkol and the second shepherd is defence minister Moshe Dayan, who took the Golan (Bashan) from Syria in the Six-Day War.

sources.name: Biblefacts.org, Seven Shepherds chart (Ken Johnson ministry)

title: Five cities speaking the language of Canaan (1967)
fulfilment: History (Johnson): an outcome of the Six-Day War
summary: Isaiah said five cities in Egypt would speak the language of Canaan. Johnson places the fulfilment in 1967. Which cities he names (probably in Sinai, then under Israeli control) could not be read.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1967 The Five Cities"

title: Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all nations
fulfilment: History: the international dispute over Jerusalem
summary: Zechariah said all nations would gather against Jerusalem and that anyone lifting it would be cut. Johnson's 2005 entry, "Palestinians claim Jerusalem", is part of this. The final siege is future.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 2005 Palestinians Claim Jerusalem"

title: Dayan recaptures the Golan in the Yom Kippur War (1973)
fulfilment: History: Yom Kippur War
summary: Johnson explains why there are eight leaders but seven shepherds: Dayan served under two prime ministers, Eshkol and Golda Meir. In 1973 he won back the Golan after Syria's surprise attack on Yom Kippur.

sources.name: Biblefacts.org, Seven Shepherds chart (Ken Johnson ministry)

title: Micah's 3rd shepherd: Sharon, Golan Heights Law (1981), Lebanon (1982)
fulfilment: History: Golan Heights Law; 1982 Lebanon War defeat of Syrian air force
summary: The fourth leader, Begin, and the third shepherd, Sharon, applied Israeli law to the Golan on 14 December 1981. In 1982 they fought Syria in Lebanon, where Syria lost about 80 MiGs and 19 missile batteries.

sources.name: Biblefacts.org, Seven Shepherds chart (Ken Johnson ministry)

title: Fall of the Berlin Wall and return from the "north country" (1989)
prophecy: Jeremiah 16:15; Isaiah 43:6 (Johnson's exact reference not seen)
fulfilment: History: the Iron Curtain opens; about one million Soviet Jews emigrate to Israel
summary: Johnson has an entry for the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989. Evangelicals tie it to God telling the north to "give up" his people. In the years after, about a million Jews left the former USSR for Israel. The reference here is inferred.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1989 Fall of the Berlin Wall"

title: Ethiopian Jews brought from beyond the rivers of Cush (1990)
fulfilment: History: Operations Moses (1984) and Solomon (24–25 May 1991)
summary: Zephaniah said worshippers from beyond the rivers of Ethiopia would bring God's offering. Johnson's heading dates the Ethiopian Jews' airlift home to 1990. Operation Solomon flew about 14,000 in 36 hours in May 1991.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1990 Ethiopian Jews Fly Home"

title: Judges restored as at the first: Sanhedrin re-formed (2004)
fulfilment: History: a 71-member Sanhedrin convened in Tiberias
summary: Johnson lists the re-establishment of the Sanhedrin in 2004 as a fulfilment. Rabbis convened a new 71-member Sanhedrin in Tiberias on 13 October 2004, which prophecy teachers see as preparing for a Temple. The reference here is inferred.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 2004 The Sanhedrin Reestablished"
Wikipedia, 2004 attempt to revive the Sanhedrin

title: Second Lebanon War: fighting over Galilee and the Golan (2006)
prophecy: Micah 5:5-6 (as read in Johnson's Seven Shepherds chart)
fulfilment: History: Israel–Hezbollah war
summary: Johnson's last fulfilled entry is the 2006 Lebanon war, which his Seven Shepherds chart describes as fought over Galilee and the Golan while Israel still held them.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 2006 Second Lebanese War"
Biblefacts.org, Seven Shepherds chart (Ken Johnson ministry)

title: Many run to and fro; knowledge increases
fulfilment: History: rapid travel, science and information technology
summary: Daniel was told to seal the book until the time of the end, when many would run to and fro and knowledge would increase. Prophecy teachers point to modern travel and the information explosion. Some read it as greater understanding of prophecy itself.

title: The gospel preached in all the world before the end
fulfilment: History: modern missions and Bible translation
summary: The gospel of the kingdom would be preached to all nations as a witness, and then the end would come. Johnson ties the push to translate Scripture to the Reformation era and his Philadelphia age (1750). The work goes on, and Revelation 14:6 has an angel completing it.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "AD 1750 Philadelphia – Missionary Church"

title: A falling away and doctrines of demons in the last days
fulfilment: History: the church's apostasy as Johnson describes it
summary: Paul foretold a departure from the faith and teachings from deceiving spirits. Johnson's book gives a whole section to the church's apostasy and its "unsound doctrines of demons". In The Rapture he places the falling away in the birth-pangs period, including "Christ consciousness" teaching.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Unsound Doctrines of Demons"

title: Perilous times and scoffers asking "Where is his coming?"
fulfilment: History: the moral and spiritual climate of the last days
summary: The last days would bring lovers of self and money, a form of godliness without power, and scoffers who deny that Christ will return. Prophecy teachers see these traits as widespread today.

title: Birth pangs: wars, famines, earthquakes, false christs
fulfilment: History: ongoing
summary: Jesus called wars, famines, pestilences, earthquakes and false messiahs the beginning of sorrows. Johnson ties the birth pangs to the time after Israel's 1948 rebirth and calls 1948 the start of the birth pangs in his Enoch reading. He also cites the Talmud's list of signs (Sanhedrin 97b).

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "The Birth Pangs"

title: Final jubilee of the Age of Grace begins (5951 AM = AD 2026)
fulfilment: Ken Johnson's Dead Sea Scroll calendar
summary: In Johnson's scheme the last 50-year jubilee of the 12th Onah starts in spring 2026 (5951 AM). He equates it with the last generation and expects revival at its start and turmoil at its end. He warns against date-setting. His Enoch page gives this jubilee as AD 2025–2075, one year off from his own conversion of 5951 AM.

sources.name: Charisma, "Is the Final Jubilee of the Age of Grace Beginning in March 2026?" (Ken Johnson interview, 30 Dec 2025)

title: Johnson's Second Coming window: 5951–6000 AM (AD 2025/26–2075)
summary: Johnson puts the Second Coming in the last century of the ninth week (5901–6000 AM, AD 1976–2075), most likely in its second jubilee (5951–6000 AM). He frames this conditionally. In an earlier book (Messianic Festivals, 2012) he put 6000 AM at roughly AD 2030–2070.

title: Possible Tribulation start: March 2067 – March 2068
summary: If the Millennium starts at 6000 AM (March 2075 – March 2076), Johnson notes that the seven-year Tribulation could begin seven years earlier, March 2067 to March 2068. He presents this as speculation.

title: 120 years of warning, 1948 to 2068
summary: Johnson applies the 120-year warning before the Flood to the last days. Counting back 120 years from 2068 gives 1948, which he calls "right on time".

title: Age of Grace ends at 6000 AM (AD 2075)
summary: In Johnson's scheme the Age of Grace (Onahs 9–12, 4001–6000 AM) ends at 6000 AM, AD 2075. The Zadok priests are said to have expected the Millennium to start then. Church fathers who held the day-for-a-thousand-years view are cited for the 6,000-year pattern.

title: Micah's 4th–6th shepherds fight in Syria, reaching Nimrod's land
summary: Johnson expects three more Israeli defence ministers (and three more prime ministers) to fight on Syrian soil. One war reaches "the entrance of Nimrod's land", which he takes to be Iraq. Christ himself is the eighth leader and seventh shepherd.

sources.name: Biblefacts.org, Seven Shepherds chart (Ken Johnson ministry)
Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "4, 5, & 6 Shepherds"

title: The West Bank becomes a sovereign state
summary: Johnson lists, as future after 2008, a sovereign Palestinian state on the West Bank. The reference here is inferred (Joel's rebuke of nations that "parted my land").

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "West Bank Becomes a Sovereign State"

title: A war with Lebanon and Jordan (Psalm 83 coalition)
summary: Johnson foresees a "Lebanese-Jordanian" war before the Tribulation. Many prophecy teachers link this to the Psalm 83 coalition of Israel's near neighbours. The reference here is inferred.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Lebanese-Jordanian War"

title: The captives of Sepharad return to the Negev
summary: Obadiah says the exiles in Sepharad will possess the cities of the south. Johnson lists a future return of Sephardic Jews.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Sephardic Jews Return"

title: Damascus becomes a ruinous heap
summary: Isaiah says Damascus will cease to be a city. Johnson and many prophecy teachers treat this as still future, since Damascus has never been wiped out completely.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Destruction of Damascus, Syria"

title: Gog and Magog invade Israel and are destroyed by God
summary: Gog of Magog leads a northern coalition against a regathered Israel living securely, and God destroys it on the mountains of Israel. Johnson calls this the first Gog-Magog war, distinct from the one after the Millennium. Chuck Smith identified Magog as Russia, with Persia, Ethiopia, Libya, Gomer and Togarmah. He expected it in the latter days and thought it might coincide with the Rapture.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "First Gog-Magog War"
Chuck Smith, Through the Bible (C2000), Ezekiel 38

title: Ten kingdoms arise before the Antichrist
summary: The fourth beast's ten horns are ten kings who rise before a little horn uproots three of them. Johnson lists the rise of ten nations as a sign before the Tribulation.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Ten Kingdoms Arise"

title: The Rapture: believers caught up to meet the Lord
summary: The dead in Christ rise and living believers are caught up at the last trump. Johnson teaches a pre-tribulation, imminent rapture, cites early writers such as Victorinus, Cyprian and Ephraim the Syrian, and sees it pictured in the Feast of Trumpets. Chuck Smith and Skip Heitzig also teach a pre-tribulation rapture.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "The Rapture of the Church"
Skip Heitzig, You Can Understand the Book of Revelation (2011), pre-tribulation premillennial
Connect with Skip Heitzig, interview with Thomas Ice on the pre-tribulation rapture (7 Oct 2011)

title: The restrainer removed; the man of sin revealed
summary: The lawless one is revealed once the restrainer is taken out of the way. Johnson places his revealing at the start of the seven years, which begins the Day of the Lord.

title: A seven-year covenant confirmed with many
summary: Daniel's 70th week is still future in Johnson's view, with the church age as a gap between the 69th and 70th weeks. It opens when the coming prince confirms a covenant for one week. Johnson calls it the Tribulation peace plan.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Tribulation Temple/Peace Plan"
Skip Heitzig, You Can Understand the Book of Revelation (2011), pre-tribulation premillennial

title: A Temple rebuilt in Jerusalem
summary: Sacrifice has to resume, and a Temple has to stand, for the Antichrist to stop the offering and sit in God's temple. Johnson cites Irenaeus and Origen for a literal Tribulation Temple.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Tribulation Temple/Peace Plan"

title: The Antichrist: the little horn and the beast from the sea
summary: A world ruler speaks great words against God, wears out the saints for 3½ years and claims to be God. The Biblefacts Revelation chart identifies the first seal's white horse with him.

sources.name: Skip Heitzig, You Can Understand the Book of Revelation (2011), pre-tribulation premillennial

title: The false prophet and the mark of the beast (666)
summary: A second beast makes the world worship the first and forces a mark without which no one can buy or sell. Johnson cites Irenaeus on the 666 name.

title: The king of the south attacks; Egypt falls to the Antichrist
summary: At the time of the end the king of the south pushes at him, and he overruns countries including Egypt. Johnson places this war in the first half of the Tribulation.

title: Two witnesses (Elijah) prophesy 1,260 days
summary: Two witnesses prophesy in Jerusalem for 1,260 days, are killed, lie in the street and rise again. Johnson identifies one as Elijah, whose ministry ends at the sixth trumpet, before the midpoint, as "the restoration of all things".

title: 144,000 sealed from the tribes of Israel
summary: Twelve thousand from each tribe are sealed before the judgments. Johnson sees them winning converts in the first half of the Tribulation.

title: The seven seal judgments
summary: The seals bring conquest, war, famine and death (a quarter of the earth), martyrs, a great earthquake with the sun darkened, and silence in heaven.

title: The seven trumpet judgments
summary: The trumpets strike a third of the land, sea, waters and lights. Then come locusts for five months and an army of 200 million that kills a third of mankind. At the seventh trumpet the kingdoms become Christ's.

title: The abomination of desolation at mid-Tribulation
summary: In the middle of the week the Antichrist ends the sacrifice and sets up the desolating abomination in the holy place. Johnson takes this as the start of the Great Tribulation, with Daniel's 1,290 days counted from it.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "The Desolating Abomination"

title: The woman (Israel) flees to the wilderness for 1,260 days
summary: The dragon is cast down and persecutes the woman, who is fed in a wilderness refuge for 1,260 days. Jesus told those in Judea to flee to the mountains.

title: The Great Tribulation: the time of Jacob's trouble
summary: The worst distress in history falls in the last 3½ years. Johnson pictures the seven-year Tribulation in the "terrible days" between Trumpets and Yom Kippur, and expects mass martyrdom of Tribulation saints.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "The Second 3.5 Years"
Skip Heitzig, You Can Understand the Book of Revelation (2011), pre-tribulation premillennial

title: The seven bowl judgments; the Euphrates dried up
summary: The bowls bring sores, the sea and rivers turned to blood, scorching sun and darkness. The sixth dries the Euphrates for the kings of the east, and the seventh brings the greatest earthquake and hundred-pound hail.

title: Mystery Babylon falls in one hour
summary: The harlot on the scarlet beast is judged, and the great city's plagues come in one day as merchants mourn.

title: Armageddon: the nations gathered against Jerusalem
summary: The kings of the earth are gathered to Armageddon and against Jerusalem, and the returning Christ destroys their armies. Johnson places Armageddon at the end of the seven years, with Christ as the last "shepherd" of Micah 5.

sources.name: Biblefacts.org, Seven Shepherds chart (Ken Johnson ministry)

title: Israel mourns for the one they pierced; all Israel saved
summary: God pours out a spirit of grace on Jerusalem. They look on him whom they pierced and mourn, and a fountain is opened for cleansing. Paul says that when the fullness of the Gentiles has come in, all Israel will be saved.

title: The Second Coming of Christ in glory
summary: After the sun is darkened, the Son of Man comes on the clouds with power, his feet stand on the Mount of Olives and he destroys the Antichrist. Johnson ties it to Yom Kippur and the Great Trump, and puts the most likely window at AD 2025/26–2075.

sources.name: Skip Heitzig, You Can Understand the Book of Revelation (2011), pre-tribulation premillennial

title: The marriage supper of the Lamb
summary: The bride has made herself ready, and those called to the Lamb's marriage supper are blessed. The Biblefacts chart places it with the Second Coming.

title: Tribulation martyrs raised to reign with Christ
summary: Those beheaded for refusing the mark live and reign with Christ in the first resurrection. Johnson places this at the Second Coming, when the raptured saints return with Christ.

title: Judgment of the nations: sheep and goats
summary: When the Son of Man comes in glory, the nations are gathered and divided as a shepherd divides sheep from goats. Johnson places this at the Second Coming.

title: Satan bound in the abyss for a thousand years
summary: An angel binds the dragon and seals him in the bottomless pit for a thousand years, so he can deceive the nations no more until they end.

title: The Millennium: Christ reigns 1,000 years (6001–7000 AM)
summary: Christ reigns from Jerusalem for a thousand years of peace, when nations no longer learn war. Johnson's calendar starts the Kingdom age at 6001 AM (AD 2076). He sees it in the Feast of Tabernacles and cites Papias, Justin, Irenaeus and Lactantius for a literal millennium.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "The Millennial Reign"
Skip Heitzig, You Can Understand the Book of Revelation (2011), pre-tribulation premillennial

title: Ezekiel's millennial Temple and river
summary: Ezekiel sees a new Temple with a river flowing east to heal the Dead Sea, and nations go up yearly to keep Tabernacles. Dispensational teachers place this in the Millennium.

title: Israel possesses its full promised borders
summary: The land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates is divided among the twelve tribes. Johnson has a section on Israel's borders in the Millennial Reign.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "Israeli Borders"

title: The last Gog-Magog revolt after the thousand years
summary: Satan is released, gathers Gog and Magog from the four corners against the camp of the saints, and fire from heaven devours them. Johnson treats this as a separate, final Gog-Magog war at the end of the Millennium.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed (2008), contents heading "The Last Gog-Magog War"

title: The Great White Throne judgment
summary: The dead, small and great, are judged from the books, and death and Hades are thrown into the lake of fire. Johnson equates it with Enoch's "great eternal judgment" in the last part of the tenth week, 6901–7000 AM.

title: Enoch's 10th week: the great judgment and a new heaven
summary: Enoch says that in the seventh part of the tenth week comes the eternal judgment, the first heaven passes away and a new heaven appears. After that come many weeks without number in righteousness. Johnson dates week 10 to 6301–7000 AM.

title: New heavens and a new earth
summary: The first heaven and earth pass away and God makes all things new. In Johnson's 7,000-year scheme this follows the end of the Millennium at 7000 AM.

title: The New Jerusalem comes down from heaven
summary: The holy city descends as a bride. It has gates of pearl and streets of gold and needs no temple or sun, because God and the Lamb are its light.

title: Death, sorrow and pain done away; God dwells with men
summary: God makes his dwelling with mankind and wipes away every tear. The last enemy, death, is destroyed.
